en.headline: 14 commits across 3 repos, comment on OpenChamber issue, new idea discussion
en.summary: Today `sogeisetsu` made **14 own commits** across three repositories. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 7 commits implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list/inspect/disable/enable acceptance, corrected the `plugin add` entry conclusion, and revised the spec to be self-contained. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 6 commits fixed repeated resident-issue creation, degraded notifier failure behavior, unified title fonts, and redesigned AI failure visibility and the 30-day summary; another **26 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`** also touched the repo. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 1 commit added an `opencode-provider` knowledge category covering catalog sources, credential ownership, and OpenChamber jurisdiction. The user commented on issue `#4939` in `openchamber/openchamber` about text selection never opening the comment menu, and started discussion `#5114` proposing a split of that fix. Two replies arrived on issues `#4601` and `#4899`, and three issues in `openchamber/openchamber` were closed by `btriapitsyn` that day.

zh.headline: 三个仓库共 14 次提交，在 OpenChamber issue 留言并发起新讨论
zh.summary: 今天 `sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库提交了 **14 次本人提交**。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 中，7 次提交实现了 `skill_management` 插件（含 list/inspect/disable/enable 验收）、更正了 `plugin add` 入口结论并将规范改为自含。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，6 次提交修复了常住 issue 重复创建、notifier 失败退化、统一标题字体，并改版了 AI 失败可见性与 30 天总结；另有 **26 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，1 次提交新增了 `opencode-provider` 知识类别，涵盖 catalog 三层来源、凭据归属与 OpenChamber 管辖。用户在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 issue `#4939` 上留言，讨论文本选中不弹出评论菜单的问题，并发起讨论 `#5114` 提议拆分该修复。收到 `#4601` 和 `#4899` 两条回复，`btriapitsyn` 当天关闭了三个 issue。
